name: Kiryuu Shinji
source:
The protagonist who was always compared to his popular brother. He became an adult without ever trusting his own family. 

When he became an adult, he was jobless and living aimlessly, but after casually trying stock trading, his talents showed great results, and now, he's living alone comfortably.

He couldn't accept that his childhood love Ayako married his hated brother, and ever since then, he hasn't came home. 

Madoka, who takes every chance to belittle Shinji as a worthless loser, always compares him to his older brother. Because of that, he never stopped resenting her. 

One day, when his brother asked him for a loan to save his company, he decided it was a good opportunity to steal everything from him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=801395]Getchu[/url]]
